title: Overnight Task Team Lead
description:
Summary:

Reporting to the Assistant General Manager (AGM), the Overnight Supervisor provides daily direction to the team members working the overnight shift within the retail store, to include: sales floor replenishment, merchandise presentation, seasonal resets, inventory management and price change execution.

Responsibilities:

  • Delegates tasks and work assignments to team members by giving clear and concise direction and follow up to ensure proper execution.
  • Ensure adherence of all standard operating procedures and processes by team members, following up to provide training and guidance when needed.
  • Maintains visual presentation standards including in-store signage, proper execution of merchandise directives and planograms, merchandise recovering/front facing and general daily recovery ensuring a pleasant and productive shopping experience for all customers.
  • Ensures nightly replenishment of sales floor from backstock inventory, as well as new replenishment from the Distribution Centers and direct vendor deliveries.
  • Supports inventory management in partnership with the Inventory Control team by completing on demand counts, empty peg scanning, pick requests, display integrities, etc. during off peak business overnight.
  • Supports the AGM with coordination of all âSpecial Eventsâ; maintenance of pricing and UPC integrity; determining proper assortments; accuracy of inventory; proper display, tagging, signing, and pricing of all advertised items.
  • Supports the AGM in carrying out Supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the Companyâs policies and applicable laws, including interviewing, training, planning, assigning, and directing work, measuring and evaluating performance, addressing complaints and resolving problems, maintaining a positive, harassment free working environment for all associates.
  • Assists the AGM and site Human Resources to staff the department with âserviceâ oriented associates; participates in interviewing and makes recommendations for selection; coordinates training; consults with AGM and gives input on preparation of performance appraisals; prepares weekly work schedules; coaches and motivates associates to promote positive customer relations and a productive team-oriented work environment.
  • ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED.

Qualifications:

  • Preferred Degree: High School Diploma or equivalent,
  • Years of experience: 2-4 years in a retail environment, preferably in a leadership or supervisory role.
  • Availability to work overnight shifts.
  • Ability to read and analyze reports.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to inquiries from Managers, team members, customers and the general public.
  • Ability to conduct meetings and presentations to groups.
  • Proficiency with PC-based word processing, spreadsheets, data-based management and inventory management systems.
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, team members, customers, and internal cross-functional partners.
